what: Groups pass a soak test (0.1.40): Stop while Claude Code still reports work stays Working until it confirms; a background turn's verdict is waited for and used only when written for this turn; notifications fire once a state held 1.5 s and never repeat the same question; watchers aren't work; a clean Stop clears an earlier limit; a finished session with a server running is Your turn; '! N unverified' when Claude Code's files can't be read; Maxwell watch
why: The groups must be trusted; one snapshot check was not enough, and the standard asks for events, not timers
evidence: Scripted background sessions (plain, background shell, async subagent, permission prompt approved via attach, AskUserQuestion, Esc, question without status line, blocked with a shell, dev server) compared against Claude Code's own files every 0.25 s: before, 3 false done notifications and the permission text overwritten; after two rounds, every change matched within 0.3 s with one notification each. An independent review's 8 findings fixed with tests

what: Panel tabs always on the stripe (0.1.42): every panel of a side keeps its tab, lit while open; clicking a lit tab hides it
why: A tab vanished as soon as its panel opened, so the edge kept changing under the pointer
evidence: Maxwell Dev snapshots: Viewer and Plugins tabs stay; clicking Viewer opens and lights it, clicking Plugins hides it and its tab stays dim

what: Quiet runs keep their windows off every screen
why: Test runs and session-started Maxwell Dev kept their window behind the user's, still on screen, and a run reopened by `open` lost --quit-after and came to the front over Robin's work
evidence: Parked at x past every screen's right edge: --snap captures at 2x, the front app never changes during a run, Settings and sign-in windows go the same way; a test run started with --quit-after 52 was found front-most 77 min later after being reopened
result: MXWindow.present parks quiet windows; quiet runs post no notifications; --retina moves the window only if its scale is wrong; .claude/settings.json refuses `open … Maxwell` from a session

what: Side panels are tabs (0.1.45): a side area shows one list or document at a time; opening one hides the others there, widgets still stack
why: Viewer and plugins stacked in one column left each too short to use; asked for tab behaviour
evidence: Maxwell Dev snapshots: clicking Viewer showed only the viewer with Plugins dim; clicking Plugins showed only plugins with Viewer dim

what: Quiet runs end and never hold the front
why: A quiet run reopened by `open` cancelled its --quit-after and sat in front for over an hour; a session-started run without --quit-after never ended; --fullscreen took a Space; --select matched only the generated name and logged success anyway
evidence: Reopen during a run: ignored and quit on time; macOS still made it front for an instant, AppKit reported no activation, a workspace observer handed the front back (polled every 0.1 s: never Maxwell Dev); --select by shown title opens it, unknown names log 'no such session'
result: Quiet runs ignore reopen, quit after 10 min by default, skip --fullscreen and give the front back; --select matches the shown title

what: ⌘N starts with the project (0.1.41): inside a project it is picked; from All projects nothing is picked until you pick; search covers session folders plus git repos in the usual code folders; home and loose folders warn
why: A user's sessions landed in another project's folder and in ~ (3 of 6 in one recording) because ⌘N reused the last-viewed session's folder and offered only 5 recent folders; the workaround was a terminal and cd
evidence: Comparable apps (Zed, Codex, Conductor, Claude desktop) start new work from a project list, not a folder dialog; Maxwell Dev snapshots of All projects, a scoped project, typing, and ⌘T on All projects
result: pass; ⌘T on All projects with nothing open now asks too

what: A claude in a Maxwell terminal takes over that terminal's row (0.1.43)
why: Running claude in a Maxwell terminal showed two rows, the session's read-only and offering Bring into Maxwell
evidence: Terminals carry MAXWELL_TERMINAL; matched from the hook's pid via sysctl KERN_PROCARGS2 (system binaries hide their environment, claude does not); Zed's Terminal Threads do the same; Maxwell Dev run: one row with the live terminal, terminal row back when claude exits
result: pass; no hook or reducer change, so sessions already running match too

why: Developers start in a terminal already in the right folder; Claude desktop (`claude --desktop`) and Codex (`codex app`) offer the same
evidence: Folder document type with handler rank None; quiet `open -g -a … <repo>` run shows the panel with the repo picked
result: pass; no command to install on PATH

what: Let go of terminals off screen for 10 minutes
why: Claude Code stops an idle background session only when nothing is attached, and Maxwell kept every terminal it opened attached until it quit, so idle sessions never freed their memory
evidence: On one Mac: 31 background sessions held 11.4 GB while 9 worked; Maxwell held 15 `claude attach` processes; the service's log showed a session it stopped after 8 hours idle that Maxwell attached again
result: TerminalRelease: off screen 10 minutes, let go; opening the session attaches again

what: A session Claude Code stops while it waits on you is parked, not ended
why: A stopped session leaves `claude agents --json`, which Maxwell read as ended, so a session waiting on you vanished from Your turn after an hour without an attached terminal
evidence: `claude agents --json --all` lists such a session as done; `claude stop` on it exits 0; `claude attach` resumes it (2.1.325)
result: It keeps its group; opening it shows the last reply and Resume instead of starting it again; parked long ago it folds into Idle
